leads.title: Brazilian Supreme Federal Court - March 2018 ruling on legal gender change
leads.documents: Transgender people may change legal gender without surgery, hormonal therapy, judicial order or medical report, via registry post application
leads.detail: Cited as: March 2018 unanimous STF ruling; reported 59% increase in gender changes at registry offices by 2024. No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Amazonas State Law No. 7,552 - signed 10 June 2025 by Governor Wilson Lima
leads.documents: Bans gender-affirming care for minors under age 18 in Amazonas
leads.detail: Cited as: Law No. 7,552, signed 10 June 2025, State Governor Wilson Lima. No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Federal Public Prosecutor's Office (MPF) recommendation - August 2024
leads.documents: Recommended Amazonas formally enable outpatient and hospital services for transsexualization process including sexual reassignment surgeries, with deadlines for approval and presentation to Ministry of Health
leads.detail: Cited as: August 2024 MPF recommendation to state of Amazonas. No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Public Defender's Office of the State of Amazonas (DPE-AM) monitoring process - November 2023
leads.documents: Monitoring of public health services for transgender and travesti people, including provision of hormones and surgeries
leads.detail: Cited as: November 2023 DPE-AM process to monitor public health services. No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Manaus municipal law banning unisex restrooms - 18 October 2022
leads.documents: Bans unisex restrooms in Manaus, signed by mayor David Almeida
leads.detail: Cited as: 18 October 2022 law signed by mayor of Manaus David Almeida. No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Amazonas State Law No. 6,463/2023 on gender-neutral language ban
leads.documents: Prohibited gender-neutral language in public and private schools; challenged via ADI by National LGBTI Alliance and Abrafh; suspended by Justice Flavio Dino injunction 29 May and confirmed by STF justices July 2024
leads.detail: Cited as: Lei Estadual no 6.463/2023 proposed by Dep. Debora Menezes (PL), 14 votes in favor 4 against; ADI to STF; Dino quote on formal unconstitutionality. No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Amazonas State Court of Justice (TJAM) booklet Lar e Direito! / Home is a Right! - August 2024
leads.documents: Guidance for LGBTQ youth expelled from homes; states conversion therapies are prohibited and ineffective
leads.detail: Cited as: August 2024 TJAM booklet Portuguese: Lar e Direito!. No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Amazonas State Public Defender's Office (DPE-AM) Working Group - 2021
leads.documents: Established Sexual Diversity, Gender Identity and Citizenship Working Group focused on human rights violations and training of security agents
leads.detail: Cited as: 2021 DPE-AM Grupo de Trabalho Diversidade Sexual, Identidade de Genero e Cidadania. No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics (IBGE) 2019 survey
leads.documents: Demographics: at least 60,000 adults in Amazonas declared homosexual or bisexual (2.7%); Manaus breakdown 46,000 (3.0%) homosexual or bisexual among 1.5M aged 18+
leads.detail: Cited as: 2019 IBGE survey. No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Brazilian Public Security Forum / Brazilian Journal of Public Security + 5 July 2025 homicide case
leads.documents: Documents anti-LGBTQ violence underreporting and increase to 43 registered cases; specific incident Fernando Vilaca de Souza beaten and killed after reacting to homophobic insults in Manaus
leads.detail: Cited as: Brazilian Journal of Public Security research; Brazilian Public Security Forum data; 5 July 2025 Manaus case with condemnation by Ministry of Human Rights and Citizenship, Order of Attorneys of Brazil, federal deputy Erika Hilton. No URL visible in text.
